newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-TIGERS' PITCHER BLAIR SUFFERS BROKEN JAW.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-TIGERS' PITCHER BLAIR SUFFERS BROKEN JAW.

text.p: Detroit Tigers pitcher Willie Blair suffered a fractured jaw after being hit by a line drive in the sixth inning of Sunday's game against the Cleveland Indians.
Blair was working on a shutout with two outs in the sixth inning when Julio Franco hit a line drive back to the mound that caromed off the right side of Blair's head.
Blair collapsed to the ground and lay motionless for five frightening minutes. He was conscious when he was carried off the field on a stretcher and taken to the hospital.
X-rays revealed a fractured jaw and Blair will be kept overnight at the hospital.

"I wish he would have caught the ball," Franco said. "It would have made me feel better to make an out. I was feeling really bad. I will keep him in my prayers. You don't want to see anyone get hurt."
Tigers reliever Doug Brocail, who worked the ninth for his first save, was clearly worried about his comrade.
"When he turned and his knees collapsed and I didn't see him move, I was concerned. You are thinking major head injury, massive concussion, anything."
Added Tigers reliever John Cummings, who replaced Blair and pitched 2 1/3 hitless innings: "It was hit pretty hard, thank God they don't use aluminum bats."
